Trump repeats disputed 9/11 role claims

During a 9/11 memorial event, former President Donald Trump recounted his involvement in the recovery efforts at Ground Zero, repeating a disputed account of being carried out by firefighters. Multiple news outlets have previously fact-checked this claim, finding it to be unsubstantiated. Trump's remarks were made while honoring the victims and heroes of the September 11th attacks.
